title: App Intake: Questions for the Team

scenes.line1: What should you ask the app team?
scenes.say: Ever seen a go-live stall because someone missed a port or forgot a compliance rule? Let's fix that with the right intake questions.
Group your intake into business, technical, non-functional, and operational. Ask about owners, users, stack, ports, uptime, and support.

scenes.label: Ports
scenes.sub: Ask for inbound and outbound ports—both directions.
scenes.say: Always get a full list of dependencies, including ports going out and coming in. Outbound to a partner is the classic gotcha.

scenes.question: What’s the most common missed item?
scenes.wrong: Inbound API port for the app
scenes.right: Outbound dependency, like a SaaS or DB port nobody mentioned
scenes.say: Most teams forget outbound ports—like a SaaS or database connection. That’s what bites you on go-live day.
